reviewContext: logmind is a deterministic Go CLI (v2.0.0, SkDD SPEC 1.3.0+). Load-bearing invariants to verify on ANY change: (1) DEFAULT-OUTPUT BYTE-PARITY - new features land behind additive config keys that default OFF and are OMITTED from DefaultMap, so logmind context / config list / timeline / file-structure bytes are unchanged when unset (the additive-key recipe; goldens captured from pre-change code). (2) MARKER-INJECTION SAFETY - any free-text CLI input written into docs markers (decision summaries, branch headlines) MUST be collapsed to a single line at one chokepoint; a multi-line value must never forge or break an entry-block marker. (3) NO GITHUB_TOKEN PUSH - CI self-heal MUST NOT push with GITHUB_TOKEN (it strands required checks); advisory warn+exit 0 or PAT-push only. (4) DETERMINISM - derived docs and the context payload are byte-identical across runs/worktrees/machines; no timestamps, abs paths, or filesystem order. (5) ENFORCEMENT CONTRACTS (SPEC 1.3.0 §15) - guard-commit exit codes are public contracts: harness block = exit 2 (the only PreToolUse-blocking code), git-hook block = exit 65 (the ONLY code the commit-msg hook maps to abort; anything else MUST fail open, incl. stale binaries). Never remove the escape hatches ([skip-logmind], LOGMIND_ALLOW_GIT_COMMIT=1) or the fail-open guarantee. (6) SPEC-FILE PATH RULE (§16) - context.spec_file resolves repo-relative only; absolute or root-escaping paths are treated as unset, never read.
